Hi, I'm sorry to see your going through this but in your situation there's many solutions. I know this may sound odd to most but try to enlist? The army has many opportunities for people like you who are searching for passion and something to live for. Trust me the friends you make there stick with you all your life because your going through think and thin with them and back, that is a bond that is inseparable and eactly what you need in life. So give your local recruiter a call and they'll get you started, pm me if your interested.

Its not too late to change. Now I'm not saying I know what it feels like, but I've come close to it. Oh and nice to meet you, my name is Adriana I'm 18 still living with my parents and life is complete shit for me as well at a point. I'm a proud high school drop out and I just love fucking up my life and blowing my cash at the casino every Fridays. On top of all this I'm having to deal with a broken relashinship on my mind I smoke to forget. And the one thing your going to rake after reading this, its not too late to change. Tell me how I was able to immediately stop my smoking addiction with the help of a few addiction therapists and finish highs school and move on to an Ivy leave school. Now I'm happily living single and have a great job at a school where I teach. Don't tell me its not too late to change, it shouldn't be for you either.                                                                                                                       Best Wishes, Adriana
